title: Making the Priestly Garments

questions.question: What garments were made for Aaron?
options: Holy garments for ministering in the Holy Place
questions.correctAnswer: Holy garments for ministering in the Holy Place
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:1 (ESV): "From the blue and purple and scarlet yarns they made finely woven garments, for ministering in the Holy Place."

questions.question: How many stones were set in the breastpiece?
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:14 (ESV): "There were twelve stones with their names according to the names of the sons of Israel."

questions.question: What was engraved on the gold plate?
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:30 (ESV): "They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engraving of a signet, 'Holy to the Lord.'"

questions.question: What did Moses do when the people finished all the work?
options: Moses saw all the work and blessed them
questions.correctAnswer: Moses saw all the work and blessed them
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:43 (ESV): "And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it; as the Lord had commanded, so had they done it. Then Moses blessed them."

questions.question: What phrase is repeated throughout this chapter about the work?
options: As the Lord had commanded Moses
questions.correctAnswer: As the Lord had commanded Moses
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:1,5,7,21,26,29,31,32,42,43 repeatedly states "as the Lord had commanded Moses."

questions.question: What was attached to the hem of the robe of the ephod?
options: Bells of pure gold and pomegranates
questions.correctAnswer: Bells of pure gold and pomegranates
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:25 (ESV): "They also made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates."

questions.question: What color was the robe of the ephod?
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:22 (ESV): "He also made the robe of the ephod woven all of blue."

questions.question: What were the onyx stones on the shoulder pieces engraved with?
options: The names of the sons of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: The names of the sons of Israel
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:6 (ESV): "They made the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold filigree, and engraved like the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the sons of Israel."

questions.question: What materials was the ephod made of?
options: Gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen
questions.correctAnswer: Gold, blue, purple, scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:2 (ESV): "He made the ephod of gold, blue and purple and scarlet yarns, and fine twined linen."

questions.question: How were gold threads made for the garments?
options: Gold was hammered into thin sheets and cut into threads
questions.correctAnswer: Gold was hammered into thin sheets and cut into threads
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:3 (ESV): "They hammered out gold leaf, and he cut it into threads to work into the blue and purple and the scarlet yarns."

questions.question: What were the coats for Aaron's sons made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:27 (ESV): "They also made the coats, woven of fine linen, for Aaron and his sons."

questions.question: How was the breastpiece attached to the ephod?
options: By a lace of blue from its rings to the rings of the ephod
questions.correctAnswer: By a lace of blue from its rings to the rings of the ephod
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:21 (ESV): "They bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue."

questions.question: How many times is the phrase "as the Lord had commanded Moses" used in this chapter?
questions.explanation: The phrase appears approximately 10 times in Exodus 39 (vv. 1, 5, 7, 21, 26, 29, 31, 32, 42, 43), emphasizing obedience.

questions.question: What was the turban made of?
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:28 (ESV): "And the turban of fine linen."

questions.question: The people brought all the finished work to whom?
questions.explanation: Exodus 39:33 (ESV): "Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses."

key_verse_text: And Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it; as the Lord had commanded, so had they done it. Then Moses blessed them.
